tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Set Text Analysis and Exam Preparation

questions.question: How would you approach a written exam question asking you to describe how you would perform an extract from your set text?
questions.correctAnswer: Read the extract carefully; identify the key dramatic moment; choose a perspective (performer/director/designer as asked); make specific staging/performance choices; justify each with reference to the text; link to the play's themes and context.

questions.question: Why is it important to understand the whole play, even though the exam only asks about extracts?
questions.correctAnswer: Extracts are shaped by the whole play — character motivations come from earlier scenes, themes run throughout, the extract's significance depends on its place in the overall structure. Without whole-play knowledge, your analysis will be superficial.

questions.question: Describe how you would answer a question from a director's perspective about staging a key scene.
questions.correctAnswer: Describe staging choices (stage type, positioning, levels); explain design choices (set, lighting, costume); justify how these communicate the scene's meaning; link to the director's concept and the play's themes; use precise theatrical vocabulary.
